objective.name: mailbox.release
objective.description: Releases a mailbox entry claimed by its owning run and returns it to pending state without undoing any already materialized effect.

#root.role: Abandon one incomplete mailbox consumption by verifying ownership and returning the claimed entry to pending state through one guarded mailbox write, while preserving all durable history and real effects.

effects.mailbox: Changes exactly one mailbox entry from claimed to pending and clears its ownership.

transformation_contract.morphing: An incompletely consumed mailbox entry owned by a run becomes pending again without reverting any durable or external effect.
invariants: Only the run owning the claimed entry may release it.
A pending entry cannot be released.
Release changes mailbox consumption state only.
The durable message is never deleted or mutated.
Release never means rollback.
Already emitted intentions are never automatically replayed.
Already materialized external effects remain real.
The entry keeps its original message_id, priority, and referenced message seq.
A release that reports a failed treatment (failed true) counts one attempt on the entry (attempts).
An entry whose treatment failed for the third time is parked: its status becomes failed instead of pending, it is never claimed again, and the messages after it are no longer blocked by it.

Mutations of the Matters of one continuity are serialized by short critical-section locks keyed by continuity_id inside the agentic_core wrapper process: a lock is held only around a read, recompute and guarded write, never during an LLM inference, an external invoke or a wait; it is never the sole guarantee.
Every write to a mutable Matter carries expected_revision; a revision conflict causes a bounded read, recompute and retry.
Revision is opaque concurrency metadata and is never used as an application sequence.
The operation mutates a single Matter through one matter.write guarded by expected_revision, and is atomic at the engine level for that Matter only.
success: The targeted entry is verified as claimed by run_id.
status becomes pending, or failed when the release reports the third failed treatment.
The entry becomes eligible for a later mailbox.read according to its existing priority and message seq, unless it is parked.
failure: Fails if the mailbox does not belong to continuity_id.
Fails if the entry does not exist.
Fails if the entry is already pending.
Fails if the entry is parked (status failed): a parked message is not released again.
Fails if claimed_by differs from run_id.
Fails explicitly with a concurrency failure when the bounded retries on revision conflict are exhausted.
notes: Executed by the agentic_core Python wrapper.
mailbox.release delegates no architectural behavior to another capacity.
Clearing runtime.current_message_id belongs to pilot.activate after a safe release.
Expected-message recovery may require coordinated runtime reconstruction; mailbox.release alone must not reinterpret an expected result as normal work.
The concurrency model of agentic_core is defined once in the document agentic_core_concurrency_model.

#resolve_state.role: Derive the three Matters owned by the target continuity from continuity_id.

failure: Fails if one of the three derived Matters does not exist.
invariants: Matter IDs follow the convention continuity_<id> (header), journal_<id>, mailbox_<id>, runtime_<id>.
Resolution is deterministic and requires no caller-provided Matter.
transformation_contract.morphing: A continuity_id becomes the physical Matter IDs of its continuity, mailbox, and runtime.

#locate.role: Resolve the mailbox entry targeted by message_id.

invariants: Lookup does not mutate mailbox state.
transformation_contract.morphing: A mailbox message identifier becomes its current mailbox entry or an explicit absence result.

#authorize.role: Verify that the targeted entry is currently claimed by the requesting run.

failure: Pending, unowned, or differently owned entries reject release.
invariants: entry.status must equal claimed.
entry.claimed_by must equal run_id.
transformation_contract.morphing: A claimed mailbox entry and run identity become an authorized or rejected release request.
success: Only the current owner of the consumption may proceed.

#release_claim.role: Clear the ownership of the authorized entry and return it to pending state through one guarded mailbox write.

failure: If the guarded write cannot be completed, the original claim remains intact.
invariants: status becomes pending and claimed_by is cleared in one mailbox write guarded by expected_revision.
priority does not change.
message_id does not change.
No other mailbox entry is modified.
transformation_contract.morphing: An authorized claimed mailbox entry becomes pending and unowned again.
success: The entry becomes available for future eligible consumption.

#preserve_effects.role: Preserve the distinction between releasing mailbox ownership and reverting already materialized execution effects.

invariants: No external effect is compensated implicitly.
No intention is automatically re-emitted.
Any future retry is a new explicit cognitive decision.
transformation_contract.morphing: A released consumption claim becomes explicitly reusable work while all prior real effects remain part of history.
